description:
List emails.

Returns sent and scheduled emails, newest first, without bodies.

Requires a `full_access` API key. API: `GET /emails` (operationId `listEmails`, Emails).

after.description: Return items older than this id (next page). Cannot be combined with `before`.

before.description: Return items newer than this id (previous page). Cannot be combined with `after`.
